title: Container crossing from Patchport to Eastmere
body: At Patchport the gantry lowers its spreader onto a blue container, lifts it over the rail and sets it into a hatch. Our 44-metre feeder carries it across Quartz Sound. At Eastmere the second crane picks the blue box up again and lowers it onto the quay.

videos.caption: Follow the blue container from the Patchport crane, across Quartz Sound and onto the quay at Eastmere.
